content:
[Intro]

[Pre-verse 1]

[Verse 1]
Stay until You're sure
that I'm asleep
Warm
safe and very still
[D/A]Give all
my things away
[Am]Just wait until
Tomorrow

[Chorus 1]
[Em/B]
Bury me in sorrow
[Gadd9/B]
Cover me in joy
[Em/B]
Bury me in sorrow
[Gadd9/B]
Cover me in joy

[Verse 2]
Every afternoon
I wasted being mad at you
[D/A]The things i never said
[Am]The things i can't say
Tomorrow

[Chorus 2]
[Em/B]
Bury me in sorrow
[Gadd9/B]
Cover me in joy
[Em/B]
Bury me in sorrow
[Gadd9/B]
Cover me in joy

[Break]

[Verse 3]
After death I'll think of you
Somehow
I'll have an e-
-ternity
[D/A]To think
about Tomorrow
[Am]Just wait until
Tomorrow

[Chorus 3]
[Em/B]
Bury me in sorrow
[Gadd9/B]
Cover me in joy
[Em/B]
Bury me in sorrow
